findings.text: follow-on: _write_run_row is added here and identically at scripts/backfill_run_durations.py:247 and reckon/ledger.py:3630, replicating the run-file amend idiom already written at reckon/ledger.py:1602 in _keep_run_files_identical and reckon/crew/promotion_release.py:546, so one mechanism now has several copies with no single owner; the completion repair added a third named copy rather than routing the callers through one, which the promotion clone detector may flag as textual duplication.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against base 2e9a07c237; eleven commits change reckon/ledger.py's guard, aggregate loader, register_member and completion repair, the five crew and script writers, three fixture files, the fold test and one evidence fragment, all inside the declared scope.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names tests/test_the_ledger_writer_refuses_a_fold.py over a 10-row aggregate and 50 per-run files, a refusal naming 50, an accepted one-run append and a hold check leaving the row count unchanged; logs/repair1-head-gate.log records 19 passed EXIT=0, logs/attempt2-negative-control-final.log records 9 failed EXIT=1 for the union write at the pre-guard base tree, and logs/repair1-negative-control.log records the reverted-repair case failing EXIT=1, so every named case is measured and logged.
item_verdicts.goal: the goal is a fold refusal in ledger.write with record_hold_checks reading the aggregate's own rows; the guard lands at reckon/ledger.py:1831, the hold check reads the aggregate at reckon/ledger.py:3858, and the repair at reckon/ledger.py:3760 now persists each repaired row where it is held, so the goal and its implied writer repointing are met.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records status complete, the head gate 19 passed EXIT=0, the pre-guard base arm 9 failed EXIT=1, the eleven-id arm 11 passed, the three files 60 passed, the other-site arm 68 passed and the reverted-repair case 1 failed EXIT=1, and names each log, though it records baseline_suite and after_suite as null.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest's declared scope (reckon/ledger.py, the five crew/script writers, register_member, three fixture files, tests/test_hold_check_leaves_the_tree_clean.py, the fold test and one evidence fragment) covers every path in git diff 2e9a07c237..9b07d3bf8; no path in the diff falls outside it.

justifications.durability: tests/test_the_ledger_writer_refuses_a_fold.py:344 fails with the fold refusal when the repair is reverted (logs/repair1-negative-control.log), and the fifty per-run files are asserted to carry the stamp at tests/test_the_ledger_writer_refuses_a_fold.py:358 against the value the stream supplied, not a value passed to write.
justifications.evidence: logs/repair1-head-gate.log ends 19 passed EXIT=0 and logs/repair1-negative-control.log ends 1 failed EXIT=1 over the cases the done_when names, but the head log carries no revision header and the manifest records baseline_suite and after_suite as null.
justifications.fit: _folded_run_ids at reckon/ledger.py:892 and _persist_repaired_rows at reckon/ledger.py:3644 follow the module's helper idiom and carry no plan or ticket label.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/ledger.py:1831 refuses an incoming row whose per-run file exists naming how many would fold, reckon/ledger.py:3858 reads the aggregate's own rows, and reckon/ledger.py:3760 persists the completion repair where each row is held.
justifications.reuse: _write_run_row is now defined three times — reckon/ledger.py:3630, scripts/derive_run_figures.py:93 and scripts/backfill_run_durations.py:247 — as the encode-and-write idiom the repository already carries at reckon/ledger.py:1602 and reckon/crew/promotion_release.py:546, with no single owner extended.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in git diff 2e9a07c237..9b07d3bf8 lies inside the scope the manifest declares.
